meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给口播、访谈或播客视频叠上跟随字幕出现的动态图形卡
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有一段口播或访谈素材,想让它看起来更精致、信息更清楚
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a talking-head or interview clip and want it to look sharper and clearer

howto.what: 给已录好的口播、访谈或播客视频叠加按台词时间同步的设计图形卡片——标题、数据标注、引用、侧栏、画中画等；原视频画面保持不变，可选 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 画布，渲染成 MP4。
howto.when: 当你提到 “graphic overlays”、“on-screen graphics” 等关键词，或要给已有口播视频加图形卡片时触发；意图不明（如纯字幕）会先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 帮我把这段口播视频加上图形卡片，做成 9:16 竖版
say.note: 先读视频与转录，再逐张设计卡片并渲染 MP4

say.text: 给这段访谈配下三分之一标题和数据标注卡片
say.note: 卡片按台词时间同步，原视频画面不变

say.text: 把这段播客重新包装一版 16:9 的屏幕图形
say.note: 卡片之间有过渡，输出一支新视频

howto.what_en: Adds timed, designed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture) to an existing talking-head or podcast video, synced to the transcript. Clip plays untouched; output 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics" or "package / dress up my video", or when you ask to add graphic cards to an existing talking-head clip. Unclear intent → /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Add graphic cards to this talking-head video and format it as 9:16
say_en.note: Reads the clip and transcript, designs each card, renders an MP4

say_en.text: Give this interview lower-thirds and data callout cards
say_en.note: Cards sync to the transcript; the video itself is untouched

say_en.text: Package this podcast clip with on-screen graphics in 16:9
say_en.note: Cards use transitions between them; a new video is output
